haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes (expires_at = created + 10 min). If the order does not confirm in time, Inventory's sweeper, running every minute, releases the reservation and the stock goes back on sale.
haiku-low.q2: Stock is reserved before the charge. Reservation is all-or-nothing: if any line is short, Inventory reserves nothing, the order is REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, no payment is requested, and the cart is untouched.
haiku-low.q3: The charge uses idempotency key = order id. On retry the provider returns the original charge instead of creating a new one.
haiku-low.q4: Order gets one fresh all-or-nothing reservation attempt. If that fails, the order goes REFUNDING, Payment refunds the full amount, then the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and the customer is emailed. Cart untouched.
haiku-low.q5: The Cart service deletes the cart only when it receives OrderConfirmed. Every failure path leaves the cart as it was.
haiku-low.q6: The Order service moves the checkout between steps. The record of progress is the order's status in Order's own database.
haiku-low.q7: The provider sends a webhook to Payment, which records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed as a broker event that Order consumes.
haiku-low.q8: Payment drops a webhook whose provider payment id is already recorded. Order acts on payment events only while the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeats find it already moved on and are ignored.
haiku-low.q9: Order asks Inventory to release the reservation immediately when PaymentFailed arrives, and the order becomes PAYMENT_FAILED. The sweeper is not involved; the cart is untouched.
haiku-low.q10: Order asks Inventory to confirm the reservation. If it has expired, Order requests one fresh all-or-nothing reservation: if all lines are in stock it commits, otherwise it refunds the full amount.
haiku-low.q11: Payment keeps the refund row PENDING and retries every 5 minutes, up to 12 tries. After the 12th failure it marks the refund MANUAL and alerts support on-call; the order stays REFUNDING. Tracked in Payment's refund row.
haiku-low.q12: The OrderConfirmed event, sent after the order is confirmed, causes the Cart service to delete the cart.

sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes (expires_at = created + 10 min). If not confirmed within 10 min, Inventory's sweeper (runs every minute) releases the reservation and the stock goes back on sale.
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved before charging. If any line is short, Inventory reserves nothing (all-or-nothing); order becomes REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, customer is shown the short items, no payment is requested, cart untouched.
sonnet.q3: The retry uses the same idempotency key (order id for a charge); the provider returns the original charge instead of making a new one.
sonnet.q4: Order makes one fresh all-or-nothing reservation attempt. If that fails, status goes REFUNDING, the full amount is refunded, then the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and the customer is emailed (refunded, item sold out).
sonnet.q5: The cart is deleted only when the Cart service receives OrderConfirmed. On every failure path the cart is left untouched.
sonnet.q6: The Order service orchestrates the steps (title and flow); the record is the order's status field in the Order service's DB, the only record of checkout progress.
sonnet.q7: Provider sends a webhook to Payment; Payment records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed as a broker event, which the Order service consumes.
sonnet.q8: Duplicate webhooks: Payment ignores (just acknowledges) a webhook whose provider payment id is already recorded. Repeated broker events: Order acts only while status is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so a repeat is ignored.
sonnet.q9: Order asks Inventory to release the reservation immediately, triggered by the PaymentFailed event; order status becomes PAYMENT_FAILED, cart untouched.
sonnet.q10: Order asks Inventory to confirm the reservation; if expired, it makes exactly one fresh all-or-nothing reservation of the same lines. If all in stock, it commits and confirms the order; if not, it refunds in full (REFUNDING, then CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK). Never partial fulfillment.
sonnet.q11: Payment's refund row is PENDING and retried every 5 minutes up to 12 tries (about 1 hour). After the 12th failure the refund is marked MANUAL and support on-call is alerted; the order stays REFUNDING. Tracking is in Payment's refund row (status, attempt count).
sonnet.q12: The OrderConfirmed event (published by Order on confirmation) causes the Cart service to delete the cart.
